description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView used to display logging information received via the LogNode interface, including formatting of log messages and chaining of LogNode handlers.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView implementation that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, with formatting based on log level, and supports chaining of LogNode instances.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors initializing the LogView with different sets of context and attributes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays log messages, including optional exception details, from various log levels.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
